evidence_quotes: op grond van artikel 5.4, eerste lid, van de Waterwet het projectplan "Stroomlijn Nederrijn en Lek spoor 4" vastgesteld.
rationale: The Dutch Raad van State decision directly concerns a ministerial decision adopting the river management project plan "Stroomlijn Nederrijn en Lek spoor 4" under Article 5.4(1) of the Water Act (Waterwet) for the Nederrijn and Lek waterways. It is substantively about public-law water and river/waterway governance under both label standards and does not involve household service connections or informal settlements.
